g.text: Filled marks and bars: median and observed min–max
of three eligible repeats in one execution class.
NO_JIT triplets use open circles and a dotted line.
Small faint open marks: individual eligible rates
from a split one/two-repeat class; no pooled median.
Lines stop at missing or different-class worker points.
Rejected synthetic NO_JIT rates are not plotted.
Three repeats are not confidence intervals.
Workload blocks are sequential; backend order rotates.
No full-grid parity or returned-body claim for synthetic KD.
